+import os
+import time
+
+
+# RC15's live view advances at 100 ms per frame (live_view.rs:36).
+FRAME_SECONDS = 0.1
+
+
+def cancel_ack_in_one_frame(session, key, label):
+    previous_count = session.text().count("Cancelled")
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    session.note(f"SEND {label}")
+    os.write(session.fd, key)
+    deadline = started + FRAME_SECONDS
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        session.pump(min(0.01, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic())))
+        screen = session.text()
+        if screen.count("Cancelled") > previous_count:
+            elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
+            session.dump(f"first-frame-after-{label}")
+            print(f"{label}_ack_seconds: {elapsed:.3f}")
+            return started
+    session.dump(f"missing-first-frame-after-{label}")
+    raise SystemExit(f"visible cancellation acknowledgment missing within one {FRAME_SECONDS:.3f}s frame")
+
+
+def wait_idle_within(session, started, label, timeout=5.0):
+    deadline = started + timeout
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        if "enter send" in session.text():
+            elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
+            session.note(f"IDLE {label} in {elapsed:.3f}s")
+            print(f"{label}_idle_seconds: {elapsed:.3f}")
+            return elapsed
+        if not session.pump(min(0.02, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic()))):
+            break
+    session.dump(f"idle-timeout-{label}")
+    raise SystemExit(f"composer did not return to idle within {timeout:.1f}s")
+
+
+def slow_sleep_processes():
+    import subprocess
+
+    result = subprocess.run(

+    )

+
+
+def wait_for_slow_sleep(session, timeout=10.0):

+        if rows:
